aboutDescription: Yahya Qanie mepụtara ngwa a site na nkwado Lena Slachmuijlder na Saji Prelis nke Search for Common Ground; Murtaza Qanie duziri mmepe teknụzụ ya. E mepụtara ya iji mee ka ozi gbasara atụmatụ Ndị Ntorobịa, Udo na Nchekwa—nke gbadoro ụkwụ na Mkpebi 2250 nke Kansụl Nchekwa Mba Ụwa—dịkwuo mfe inweta, nakwa iji wusie mmegharị YPS ike n’etiti otu dị iche iche, ndị ọkà mmụta na ndị na-eme amụma.
aboutSourcesDescription: Ngwá ọrụ a gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ n'usoro ihe ọmụma nke na-agụnye mkpebi na ụkpụrụ UN dị n'ihu ọha, akwụkwọ UN, akwụkwọ nhazi mpaghara, atụmatụ na atụmatụ mba, nchọpụta agụmakwụkwọ, na akwụkwọ sitere na ọha mmadụ na ndị na-abụghị ndị gọọmentị.
